hook: The UK must admit its secret order to Apple.
hookText: UK forced to admit secret Apple order

beats.say: For years the UK would neither confirm nor deny issuing Apple a Technical Capability Notice over encrypted iCloud data.
These secret orders come under Section 253 of the Investigatory Powers Act 2016, which let the government require tech companies to change their services, while keeping the order itself secret.
Now the Investigatory Powers Tribunal has ruled the government must acknowledge it, after Liberty and Privacy International challenged the secrecy.
